verdict.rationale: An identity platform could plausibly ship in-product AI insights, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence describes AI-generated insights or suggestions inside Entra ID. The 'data insights' from routing activity logs to external endpoints and the Graph API's 'people-centric data and insights' are data-access or export features, not in-product AI analysis.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
